name: University of Tennessee Southern
tuition_note: Tuition & fees approx $11,246/year and residential dorms & meals approx $10,400/year from utsouthern.edu/cost-and-aid (Cost and Aid at a Glance). Private university with a single published rate for all students (no out-of-state tuition). Only combined room+board figures are published (dorms+meals ~$10,400; apartments/single rooms w/ meal plan $11,960); no room-only figure available. Page does not state an explicit academic year (references FAFSA deadline April 15, 2024).
